helpArticles.title: Getting started with 19xbet365
helpArticles.body: 19xbet365 is a free-to-play demonstration platform. Create an account, explore the sportsbook and games, and use coins to try every interaction. Coins have no cash value and cannot be purchased, withdrawn, or exchanged.

helpArticles.title: How coins work
helpArticles.body: Coins are the only balance used on 19xbet365. They are granted for demonstration and cannot be bought or redeemed. Every stake, payout, and adjustment is recorded in your wallet history. Real-money deposits and withdrawals are disabled.

helpArticles.title: Placing a sports bet
helpArticles.body: Open any sport, choose a match, then tap one of the odds buttons to add a selection to your bet slip. Enter a stake and confirm. A single selection creates a single bet; two or more create an accumulator. All bets use coins and are limited to demo fixtures.

helpArticles.title: Cashing out in Crash Orbit
helpArticles.body: After launching a Crash Orbit round, the multiplier starts at 1.00x and climbs. Press Cash Out before the round ends to bank your stake multiplied by the current value. If the round ends first, the stake is lost. Auto cash-out can be set before launch.

helpArticles.title: How outcomes are generated
helpArticles.body: Playable 19X Originals rounds are generated on the server using cryptographically secure random values. The client never decides an outcome. Completed rounds are recorded in your activity history. Third-party provider titles are disabled until certified integrations are connected.

helpArticles.title: Responsible play tools
helpArticles.body: Use Responsible Gaming in your account to set a daily coin limit, a session reminder, a cool-off period, or a self-exclusion. These controls apply to this demo and are recorded for transparency.

helpArticles.title: Account verification and security
helpArticles.body: Keep your password private. 19xbet365 staff will never ask for your password or a one-time code. You can review active sessions and sign out other devices from Security settings. Two-factor authentication is available as a demonstration control.

helpArticles.title: Inviting friends
helpArticles.body: Share your referral code from your profile. A referred player receives the standard welcome allocation and you receive a referral reward once they complete their first round. Referring a player never grants administrative access.

helpArticles.title: Why some games say integration-ready
helpArticles.body: 19xbet365 labels third-party titles clearly. An integration-ready game has a complete catalogue page but no live provider session, dealer feed, or real-wager engine. This is not an error: it shows exactly where a licensed provider connection would plug in.

helpArticles.title: Contacting support
helpArticles.body: Open a support ticket from the Help Centre with your account email and a clear description. For security, never include your password. Response times shown in the support centre are illustrative for this foundation build.
